data.headline: The Great Emu War of 1932
data.subheadline: Australia declared war on birds. The birds won.

data.title: This Actually Happened
data.body: Australia deployed soldiers with machine guns to cull 20,000 emus destroying farms. The emus split into small groups, outsmarted the military, and survived. The operation was called off.

data.title: Why the Emus Won
items: Emus can run 30 mph and zigzag

manifest.caption:
Australia went to war with emus in 1932.

They lost.

Seriously.

The military fired 10,000 rounds and killed maybe 50 birds.

The emus outsmarted them and won.

Nature: 1, Humans: 0

sourceArticle.title: The Great Emu War: When Australia Lost to Birds
